g.text: Native tool routes and equal four-read work: formal observations

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Independent random files; single reads have no intentional delay. Each serial/batch read has the same 250 ms fixture delay. Lines pair equal four-read work.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: Fresh service/state per point; shared installation and OS caches retained. Row scales differ. Native context, provider protocol and route responsibilities differ.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif

g.text: MCP fixture is inside product cgroup; model/controller and memory reader are outside. Scripted counters are not real tokens or invoice cost.
